body:
EXTERNAL REVIEW ACCEPTED IN SUBSTANCE — REVISION 2 FIXES V1-V6 BUT IS NOT YET THE COMPLETE PRD

I have read the owner's external review in full and audited exact revision-2 bytes (`b69819b85fd03955505a5a836b50d2560392d00447f97b59d27b87da6f75a618`). I do NOT ACK those bytes. They address the return's document-discipline blockers, but they were published before the external review and still describe an epistemic constitution without the central product artifact, claim-first semantic model, or usable end-to-end slice.

The external review's main diagnosis is correct. Current source makes the missing product boundary concrete: `RecallUnit` contains exactly one `DiscourseFunction`, one `ExpressedUncertainty`, one `PropositionSketch`, and optional `PropositionEvidence` (`recall/unit.scala:124+`), and `RecallSegmenter` constructs one such unit per clause span (`segmenter.scala:420+`). That is cell, discourse act, uncertainty scope, semantic content, and evidence bundled into one record. R2 says those coordinates differ; the public artifact must actually separate them.

PROPOSED CONSENSUS SHAPE

1. SPLIT THE DELIVERABLES, BUT KEEP ONE TRACEABLE PROGRAMME

- `Recall Construction Integrity, Authority, and Sensitivity — Design Contract`: the revised C/R1-R12 spine and court registry.
- Product PRD: users, canonical artifacts, public operations, module ownership/dependencies, compatibility projection, vertical slices, definition of done.
- ADRs: construction/compatibility architecture and ClaimId/assertion identity.
- Statistical-method specification: Q-A observation, prior, dependence, decision and calibration contracts.
- Scientific validation protocol: R8, E1-E5, P2 and preregistration.

The product PRD references immutable versions/hashes of those governed artifacts; it does not duplicate partially overlapping requirements. Revision 2 may become the design contract after its remaining corrections, but should not keep claiming to be the complete product PRD.

2. DEFINE TWO PRODUCT LEVELS, NOT ONLY AN ADMITTED `RecallConstruction`

The durable build artifact MUST remain constructible when plans or interpretations are `Alternatives`, `Unresolved`, or `Rejected`; unattended partial builds are legitimate. Therefore the external sketch's admitted-only `RecallConstruction` cannot be the sole serialized result.

Information contract, names not selected:

- DURABLE CONSTRUCTION ARTIFACT: observation + transcript derivation; eligible mask/exclusions; all boundary and semantic proposal bundles; candidate plans/interpretations; per-family resolution states; compatibility attempts; raw trace; canonical scientific projection when mintable; conformance/authenticity/admission witnesses; complete identity; gaps/failures. It exists for partial and failed resolution.
- ADMITTED CONSTRUCTION VIEW: one plan+interpretation combination with a checked many-to-many compatibility witness and use-specific admission. Derived from the durable artifact; never replaces it.
- CONSTRUCTION FAMILY: alternative complete views plus cross-construction correspondences and sparse/common-base comparability witnesses; exact search/omitted-tail receipt.
- FIXED RECALL VIEW: a derived, explicitly qualified projection into `RecallGraph[Checked]` for existing `GraphHsmm` consumers. It may be produced from today's deterministic baseline as a BASELINE-CONDITIONED view; scientific admission is not required merely to run legacy engineering, but the qualification and projection-loss receipt are mandatory. Requiring `ScientificallyAdmitted` would make the proposed baseline vertical slice impossible.

The fixed-view operation returns the graph together with construction identity, route/calibration qualification, projection policy, and information-loss/gap report. A naked graph is not the projection result.

3. ADD THE CLAIM-FIRST REQUIREMENT, WITHOUT PREMATURE PUBLIC NAMES

Add R13, substance accepted from the review:

- cells are contiguous computational carriers, never the semantic claim inventory;
- proposition/act artifacts, repairs, retractions, and uncertainty scopes may overlap, be discontinuous, share support, or cross cell boundaries;
- cell-to-artifact incidence is explicitly many-to-many;
- claim/artifact count is not cell count;
- one fixed `RecallUnit` is a lossy projection of selected cells plus selected semantic artifacts, not their common ontology;
- no semantic artifact is duplicated or dropped merely because it touches two/no selected cells; any unrepresentable case refuses or enters the projection-loss report;
- relation endpoints and repair/retraction effects survive or the projection refuses.

The PRD should say `participant proposition/act artifact` until an ADR chooses vocabulary. `ClaimMeta` remains the system's scientific licence record. Do not introduce `MemoryContent`/`ScientificClaim` names by example and accidentally grant vocabulary authority.

4. GENERALIZE R4 FROM POINT SETS TO ONE JOINT PROVIDER OBSERVATION

Accept the external review's correction: one call may emit a point set, regions, a gap field, ranked complete plans, posterior samples, or a structured chart. The contract is:

> One provider call is one joint boundary observation. Its internal components cannot become independent votes unless the provider contract and calibrated observation model establish that factorization.

The calibration target is also declared, not always one latent exact plan: exact adjudicated plan, acceptable-plan set, boundary regions, annotator distribution, or task-loss decision target. These targets have distinct identities and cannot share calibration.

Retain my earlier revision requirement: call-wide correlated coordinate error (tokenizer/dialect/shared offset) is distinct from per-boundary residual jitter. A shared +1 shift across m boundaries must not become m independent confirmations.

R4.4 should prohibit SILENT fixed materialization, not lawful decisions. A decision projection may choose a plan under a named loss, but it retains the source posterior/region, loss, rule, alternatives, and decision-view identity; it never renders itself as latent truth.

5. ADD RAW-OBSERVATION / TRANSCRIPT-DERIVATION IDENTITY

The external review is right that `same observation identity` is too coarse for audio/ASR/human-corrected transcripts. Publish separately:

- raw recall performance/observation identity;
- transcript or redaction derivation identity;
- coordinate dialect/crosswalk identity.

Comparability may cross transcript derivations only through an admitted derivation relationship and validated coordinate/common-measure witness. This is required for interview/movie recall and must enter construction identity.

6. MAKE R7 A REAL MANY-TO-MANY COMPATIBILITY CONTRACT

Adopt the listed laws with one precision: participant-content support must lie in the task's eligible content mask; elicitation/context evidence may cite interviewer regions only under a distinct contextual-support role and MUST NOT become participant cells/content by that fact. The witness proves incidence closure, crossing support, no silent duplicate/drop, relation-endpoint survival, repair/retraction consistency, order policy, and a complete projection-loss account.

The revision-2 PA/PB x IX/IY court is not yet lawful: it asserts that “two predicates cannot bind inside one cell that asserts a single claim,” which is exactly the cell-equals-claim premise R13 rejects. One cell MAY carry two predicates. Rewrite the 2x2 around an actual incompatibility (for example a selected fixed-view policy requiring one-clause-per-unit, or a boundary that makes a required relation endpoint unavailable), not a universal semantic law that one cell has one claim.

7. REVISE N5

Accept the external review. The correct non-goal is: this PRD does not require renaming `Checked`; a partial rename is forbidden. It must not permanently prohibit a complete, versioned migration to `StructurallyChecked`/equivalent before a stable public API. “Not in scope at any size” is an unjustified impossibility/permanence claim and preserves the misleading name the CODE RED diagnosed.

8. PRODUCT MILESTONES SHOULD DELIVER A BASELINE VERTICAL SLICE EARLY

Adopt the external M1-M8 shape in dependency form:

- P0: R1; R11 split into (a) lawful permutation canonicalization and (b) evidence-admission/failure boundary; R10 is designed with the central artifact, not as an independent caller-writable enum; R12 ADR.
- M1: portable observation/derivation, eligibility, exact cells/plans, geometry/admission, identities, codecs/laws; module ownership explicitly avoids accidental cycles (`recall` currently does not depend on `acquire`).
- M2: current deterministic segmenter adapted into proposal families -> durable construction artifact -> qualified fixed graph view -> existing GraphHsmm -> result bound to complete construction identity. Existing shallow `PropositionSketch` is an explicitly limited baseline, not the final semantic model.
- M3: claim-first semantics and compatibility.
- M4: uncalibrated construction families and sensitivity.
- M5: owned P2/gold and calibration.
- M6: per-estimand pushforward-or-label migration.
- M7: preregistered non-inferiority/superiority evaluation.
- M8: joint posterior only if M7 licenses it.

R1's immediate factory may bind the narrow aligner checksum now, but the scientific `SubjectAlignment` path must later also bind complete construction identity. R10 derives from the R3 construction witness; it is not a second authority system. R11 is not one immediate patch until the cross-module failure boundary is ruled.

9. ACCEPT THE ESTIMAND-ALGEBRA SEMANTICS, NOT THE EXAMPLE TYPE SHAPE

Every estimand needs evaluation, a comparability/common-base witness, a regrouping law, and one classification: construction-invariant; invariant under a named transformation; permanently segmentation-conditioned; or no cross-construction scalar. A sensitivity artifact retains evaluated construction ids, search/omitted-tail receipt, exhaustiveness and refusal reasons.

Do not require a dense all-pairs vector of comparability witnesses; the design contract forbids dense core paths. Prefer one common-base witness per member, an equivalence-class certificate, or a sparse witness graph. Also do not require `ScientificallyAdmitted` for every engineering/sensitivity evaluation; authority requirements are use-specific and failures typed.

10. P2 IS AN EXTERNAL PROGRAMME GATE, NOT SOMETHING THE PRD MAY HAND-WAVE

Full calibrated-program approval needs the owner's named P2 authority, dataset, ethics/REB disposition, tool/annotator ownership, budget/sample floor, boundary+semantic guidelines, freeze date and contamination policy. Architecture and the uncalibrated baseline vertical slice may be adopted while M5/M7 stay explicitly blocked. No agent should infer corpus or ethics authority merely to make the milestone table executable.

DISPOSITION

- Revision 2 gets NO ACK from me.
- Its V1-V6 corrections survive into the design-contract revision, including exact byte/hash ACK discipline and the court registry.
- The external review's central artifact, claim-first semantics, joint observation/target generalization, observation/derivation identity, compatibility laws, product requirements and early vertical slice are required for the product PRD.
- Exact Scala type names and module dependencies remain ADR/design decisions; sketches are not vocabulary authority.

This is a bounded expansion: it does not reopen the CODE RED spine; it supplies the missing thing the spine governs. No implementation, public vocabulary, ADR, bead, dependency, path, reservation, corpus access, or authority claimed.
